summary: No operator website. Presence passes on Google: listed open, 4.7 stars from 30 reviews, (719) 348-5111 (matches the stored phone), most recent review 2 months ago ('Great response for reservations'). Price rests on the stored RV Life $$ tier; no posted or dated camper rate found (Campendium page would not load). Added reported 'no showers'. Note trimmed of the RV Life line.
flags: Presence: Google listing only (30 reviews, phone (719) 348-5111, not marked closed); no website or booking engine. Price: RV Life $$ tier only.

Long-stay mix and condition: recent Google reviews mention a ~6-month stay with metered power, and one (5 months ago) says the park has 'gone downhill ... full of potholes, grown up grasses, debris, long term renters ... falling down utility poles and uneven sites'; others (2 months and a year ago) describe a clean, quiet one-night stop. Not long-stay in character on this evidence, but condition is mixed.
